reviews.text:
Misleading and unsatisfactory outcome. I subscribed to YouCam Plus specifically to restore, enhance, and colourise old family photos. What I received was far more restricted than advertised, with core AI features locked behind an additional Pro upgrade, even after paying for Plus.

After only one or two uses, I was repeatedly blocked and prompted to upgrade again. This was not clearly disclosed before purchase and made the Plus plan effectively unusable for its intended purpose.

Customer support has been equally disappointing. I was incorrectly told my purchase was through Google Play (it was not), and after explaining this multiple times and requesting a refund due to misleading functionality, I received either templated responses or no response at all.

For comparison, I used Remini, which delivered significantly better results, clearer pricing, fewer restrictions, and far superior photo restoration quality. Remini did in minutes what YouCam failed to do after multiple paywalls.

I would not recommend YouCam Plus. The pricing structure feels misleading, and customer support does not resolve legitimate issues. There are better, more transparent alternatives available.
